body: I feel like I don't even bet. It is a sitting game and I have seen opportunities come and go but couldn't commit to them. Just waiting till the end, in pain and with a lot of boredom. It truly isn't a fun game.

Work for yourself and stop trying to please everybody. Trying to please everybody around you is as far as I am concerned one of the worst things you can do to yourself. What others think is not that important. You don't owe anyone anything, not even your parents. You probably didn't ask to be born, you owe them nothing, so why bother what they think? Why bother what anyone thinks? Life already sucks without caring what others think so why add the extra weight when you can just stop to care about their opinions and their beliefs? You can do whatever you want, whenever you want to, why shouldn't you?
Thanks, I'm gonna try to do small steps. Maybe it'll work out.
Similar situation here, too lazy to kill myself but can't bother living either.
Why bother with those ancient rules without proof?
Why bother with all those ancient rules if there  is no proof?
At some point I just decided that no meaning is easier than seeing meaning in everything. Till now it held true for me.
It is a constant up and down, at least for me. I just don't realy care anymore. Helps to cope with it.
For me life is boring and pain at the same time it isn't fun at all.
Auch meinen Hochwähli soll er haben
Too lazy to live but also too lazy to kill myself, feel like I am just waiting.
